Daniel P. Fitzgerald, Clerk

Clerk's Office

​The Township Clerk maintains the records of the Township as the secretary of the township board.  The clerk must certify signatures on certain documents, keep an accurate record of all meetings and is responsible for publishing notices and ordinances of the Township.  The Clerk also serves as the Chief Election Official of the Township and works with the County Clerk's office in this capacity. 

Contact Clerk Fitzgerald

information about our services

Barrington Township - Your Trusted Partner for Government Services

At Barrington Township, we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality unduplicated government services to our residents. With years of experience in the industry, our team can help you navigate the complexities of many government regulations and procedures. Whether you need assistance with any tax assessment services, permits, or compliance, food pantry, unincorporated road and bridge services, well water testing, notary service, Senior or disabled PACE or low cost taxi ridership, or have an emergency financial assistance need we have the knowledge and expertise to help you. Our commitment to excellence and resident satisfaction has earned us a reputation as one of the top providers of government services.

Get started with any questions today

Contact us now to learn more about our services and how we can help you. Our team is available to answer many questions you may have and then provide you with a potential solution that meets your needs.

Ways to Vote

Voter Registration

Voter Registration

 There are three ways to cast a ballot in suburban Cook County Elections. 


Eligible voters can participate in:


  1. Early Voting
  2. Vote by Mail - Application
  3. Election Day at the assigned polling place.

Voter Registration

 Registering to vote has never been easier or more convenient. You can register online, in person or download the registration form and register through the mail. 


Below you will find information for the four ways to register during the standard voter registration period. 


Please make sure to check the specific deadline for the form you select as dates differ depending on the method of registration.
